cells.gaps: The one source, published in November 2018, describes two local government areas of Edo State, Oredo and Egor, using the app from March 2017; it gives the state's total as 18 in one place and 19 in another, and no national total. Whether the two still use it is not established: nothing on a local government area is dated since. Where the record is held is not stated. The state ownership of 2017 falls outside the 36 months, so governance and the last twelve months hold nothing.
cells.note: Revenue agents of two local government areas outside the capital register payers and collect against a taxpayers' database, which is a register in use. Stage 4 needs more than half of local government areas on a share or a count with a denominator, and the evidence counts two in one state.
